SWE.Title: Simple weapon editor
SWE.OverLimit: Property runes exceed the potency limit
SWE.NotAWeapon: This editor only works on weapons.
SWE.OverLimitBlocked: Too many property runes for that potency. Enable GM free mode to save anyway.
SWE.SettingGmOnlyHint: If disabled, players who own a weapon can also open the editor.
SWE.NoRuneDesc: No description found in the compendium for this rune.
SWE.DerivedPriceHint: Total value computed by the system (base price + runes). Read only.
SWE.TotalPriceHint: Total price shown on the sheet. Type a custom value to override it; clear the field to go back to the automatic price.
SWE.SplashHint: hits everything within 5 ft on a hit; the target keeps it even on a miss. Uses the base damage type.
SWE.EditInConds: Edited in the Conditions tab. Deleting here removes the condition.
SWE.SplashBlockHint: own amount and type; also hits everything within 5 ft
SWE.SaveTitle: Save or check to resist this damage
SWE.DcAutoHint: Wielder's spell DC, or class DC if they have none (0 if neither).
SWE.NoStatistic: the target has no such statistic; resolve manually
SWE.NoteHalf: Roll the save, then the damage button: full on a failure, half on a success, none on a critical success.
SWE.NoteNone: Only on a failed save, roll the damage button and apply it.
SWE.HitCondsHint: conditions applied when the strike connects
SWE.HitCondValue: Value, for conditions that have one (e.g. frightened 2)
SWE.StrikingIgnored: striking does not change the dice here (manual dice count)
SWE.PriceFloor: Runes alone are worth more than that; minimum total
SWE.CondHint: Effects that only apply depending on who carries the weapon.
SWE.CondUnknown: This option is not in any installed compendium, so it will never match
SWE.CondNoTarget: Conditions with nothing selected were not saved
SWE.Filter_map: is attacking with the multiple attack penalty (MAP)
SWE.Filter_selfCondition: the wielder is suffering the condition
SWE.Filter_targetCondition: the target is suffering the condition
SWE.BonusTypeHint: Bonus type. Same-type bonuses do not stack with each other; untyped ones always do.
SWE.BonusValueHint: Modifier to the attack roll. Negative values are penalties.
SWE.MinHint: Minimum value (e.g. 2 for frightened 2 or more). Leave empty to just require the condition.
SWE.Effect_healTurn: healing at the start of the turn
